Airport → Paris by Train

Two trains, one transfer. Arrows show the direction of travel — tap a button to flip between arriving and leaving.

✈️ → 🗼 Airport to the Eiffel Tower
🗼 → ✈️ Back to the airport

Arriving: CDG Airport → Eiffel Tower (about 1 hour)

1
Follow signs for “RER B / Trains to Paris”In any terminal. At the ticket machines, buy a “Paris Airport Ticket” — about €14 each. A normal metro ticket won't work from the airport.
2
Board RER B toward ParisEvery train from the airport goes into the city — you can't get on the wrong direction here. Ride about 35 minutes.
3
Get off at Saint-Michel – Notre-DameA few stops after Gare du Nord and Châtelet. Follow signs for RER C inside the station (short walk, no new ticket needed).
4
Board RER C toward “Pontoise” / “Versailles” / “St-Quentin”Any of those names on the sign means the train is heading west — the right way. Ride 4 stops, about 10 minutes.
5
Get off at Champ de Mars – Tour EiffelYou'll come up right beside the Tower. Welcome to Paris.
Tired after the flight, or lots of luggage? A taxi from the official rank is a fixed €65 to the Eiffel Tower side (Left Bank) — no meter surprises. Split three ways, it's honestly a good deal.

Leaving: Eiffel Tower → CDG Airport (about 1 hour — leave 3.5+ hrs before the flight)

1
Go to Champ de Mars – Tour Eiffel stationBuy a “Paris Airport Ticket” (~€14) at the machine, or just tap a contactless bank card — it charges the airport fare automatically.
2
Board RER C toward “Gare d'Austerlitz” / “Juvisy” / “Massy”Any of those names means the train is heading east — the right way. Ride 4 stops.
3
Get off at Saint-Michel – Notre-DameFollow signs for RER B inside the station.
4
Board RER B — the sign MUST say “Aéroport Charles de Gaulle”This is the one thing to check: some RER B trains on this platform go to “Mitry-Claye” instead, which is not the airport. If the board says CDG, you're good. Ride ~35 min.
5
Get off at your terminal“Aéroport CDG 1” for Terminals 1 & 3 · “Aéroport CDG 2” for Terminal 2 (most international flights). Check the terminal on the ticket.
Taxi option: from the Left Bank a fixed €65 to CDG. Book on the G7 app the night before with a set pickup time — the least stressful way to make a morning flight.

Prices & times

Airport train ticket (RER B + transfer)~€14 per person
Any ride inside Paris (metro / RER)~€2.50 tap-to-pay
Taxi CDG ↔ Left Bank (Eiffel side), fixed€65 total
Taxi CDG ↔ Right Bank, fixed€56 total
RER B runs~4:50am – 11:50pm, every 10–15 min
Flying into Orly instead? Take Metro line 14 straight from the airport into the city (~€13, 25 min), get off at Madeleine or Châtelet, then a taxi or metro to the hotel. Or a fixed-rate taxi: €36 to the Left Bank.

Safety Notes

Keep it simple

  • Bags in front, zipped — especially at the Tower, Trocadéro, Sacré-Cœur, and on the metro.
  • Only use the official taxi rank or the G7 / Uber apps — never someone offering a ride in the arrivals hall.
  • Ignore anyone asking you to sign a petition or offering a “free” bracelet — the classic tourist-area scams. Just keep walking.
  • This page works offline — the maps are built into the file, no signal needed.
Made with care, so all you have to do is show up.
